question: When does the admission process start and what is the last date to apply?
expected_answer: Admissions open on May 1st and close on June 30th (late applications accepted until July 15th with late fee).

question: How can I apply for undergraduate admissions online?
expected_answer: Register on the Demo University Admissions Portal (admissions.demouniv.edu), submit online form, upload certificates, and pay $50 application fee.

question: Is there an entrance exam for admission to Demo University?
expected_answer: Yes, Demo University conducts the Demo University Common Entrance Test (DUCET) for B.Tech and MBA programs.

question: What undergraduate engineering courses are offered?
expected_answer: Four-year B.Tech programs in Computer Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.

question: Are postgraduate and doctoral degree programs available?
expected_answer: Yes, Demo University offers M.Tech, MBA, M.Sc in Data Science, and Ph.D. research fellowships.

question: Can undergraduate students choose interdisciplinary minors?
expected_answer: Yes, students can take minors in Computational Finance, Cybersecurity, Environmental Studies, and Product Design from 3rd semester.

question: What are the eligibility criteria for B.Tech Computer Science?
expected_answer: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/CS with minimum 60% aggregate (55% for reserved categories).

question: What are the eligibility requirements for the MBA program?
expected_answer: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate and valid DUCET-Management, CAT, or GMAT score.

question: Are international students eligible to apply?
expected_answer: Yes, with AIU credential equivalence and valid English proficiency scores (TOEFL or IELTS).

question: What is the annual tuition fee for B.Tech programs?
expected_answer: Annual tuition is $4,000 (INR 3,20,000) payable in two installments plus a refundable security deposit of $300.

question: What is the fee structure for MBA programs?
expected_answer: Total two-year program fee is $9,500 (INR 7,60,000) including tuition, course materials, simulation labs, and industry immersions.

question: What is the refund policy if a student withdraws admission?
expected_answer: 100% minus $20 if 15 days before classes; 80% within 15 days before; 50% within 15 days after; 0% after 30 days.

question: Does Demo University offer merit-based scholarships?
expected_answer: Chancellor's Merit Scholarship awards up to 100% waiver for top 1% in DUCET, and 50% for above 90% in 10+2.

question: Are there need-based or sports scholarships available?
expected_answer: Need-cum-Means Grant up to 40% tuition for family income under $8,000, and Sports Excellence Fellowships for national medalists.

question: What hostel facilities and room types are available on campus?
expected_answer: AC and non-AC hostels for boys and girls with single, double, and triple-occupancy rooms with 24/7 Wi-Fi, laundry, and dining.

question: What is the annual hostel and mess fee?
expected_answer: Hostel fee ranges from $1,200 to $2,200 annually, with a mess fee of $900 per year.

question: What are the central library working hours and digital resources?
expected_answer: Central Library operates 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekends, with 24/7 reading halls during exams.

question: What is the mandatory attendance requirement to appear for examinations?
expected_answer: Minimum 75% attendance in each registered course is required for end-semester examinations.

question: Does the university provide bus transportation services for day scholars?
expected_answer: Yes, 25 GPS-tracked AC buses cover major routes within a 45-km radius of campus.

question: What are the contact details and working hours of the Admissions Helpdesk?
expected_answer: Phone: +1 (555) 019-2830, Email: admissions@demouniv.edu, Welcome Centre Admin Block, Mon-Fri 9 AM - 5 PM.

question: What is the final cutoff date for submitting college application forms?
expected_answer: Applications close on June 30th, with late submissions until July 15th.

question: Could you tell me how much I need to pay every year for engineering tuition?
expected_answer: Annual tuition for B.Tech is $4,000 (INR 3,20,000) per year.

question: Do I have to write any test to secure an admission seat in BTech?
expected_answer: Yes, DUCET (Demo University Common Entrance Test) is required, or top 5% national score.

question: What percentage in high school is necessary to get into CSE?
expected_answer: At least 60% aggregate in 10+2 with Physics, Math and Chemistry/CS.

question: What is the minimum attendance needed so I don't get debarred from writing exams?
expected_answer: At least 75% attendance is required to sit for end-semester exams.

question: Can students stay in university dorms and what kinds of rooms do you have?
expected_answer: Yes, hostels provide single, double, and triple-occupancy rooms with AC or non-AC options.

question: How much does eating in the mess and boarding in hostel cost in total?
expected_answer: Hostel fee is $1,200 to $2,200, plus mess charges of $900 annually.

question: Till what time is the library open in the evening on weekdays?
expected_answer: Open until 10:00 PM on weekdays (opens at 8:00 AM).

question: Is bus facility available for students commuting from home?
expected_answer: Yes, Demo University runs 25 GPS-tracked AC buses covering up to 45 km radius.

question: Are there any fee discounts or waivers for students with high marks?
expected_answer: Yes, Chancellor's Merit Scholarship gives up to 100% waiver for top 1% DUCET scorers.

question: What papers do I need to bring when I come for document verification?
expected_answer: 10th and 12th marksheet/certificates, TC, migration certificate, photos, and ID proof.

question: What happens if I fail a subject, can I give a re-exam?
expected_answer: Students with 'F' grades can take supplementary examinations held in July and January.

question: Can an undergrad choose subjects from other fields like Cybersecurity?
expected_answer: Yes, interdisciplinary minors in Cybersecurity, Finance, etc., are available from 3rd semester.

question: Will the university refund my money if I decide to cancel my seat before classes?
expected_answer: 100% refund (minus $20) if withdrawn 15 days before classes commence.
